cite: reference/decompiled/shs3_android_payload/scripts/BG_Loader.as:248-252, contrasted with :188-191, :209-212, :229-232 and :260-263

cite: reference/decompiled/shs3_android_payload/scripts/BG_Loader.as:182, :205, :225, :245, :257
lane_impact: L6 art-anim + method. The stems are 80.013 s and 45.741 s, not 79.872 and 45.760; slash1 is 0.345 s, not 0.572 s. Timing a WebAudio recreation to the afinfo numbers would run the whole SFX bed 66% long.

text: The engine's own letterbox/pillarbox algorithm, which resolves the apparent 800x690-vs-800x480 contradiction between the web SWF header and the longplay frames. The base canvas is 800x480; 690 is 800x480 plus a 210px friend bar that is only shown when the window is TALLER than 800/690. The engine fits width or height, centres with an offset, and publishes stageScale / stageOffsetX / stageOffsetY / stageFitWidth / stageBaseWidth / stageBaseHeight — the same values InputManager uses to convert mouse coordinates back into stage space.
